bio.text: Morgan Dawicki announced a run for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts as an independent on July 4, 2025; it was his first time running for the office.
He was born in New Bedford, Massachusetts, and has been chief operating officer of the Northeast Maritime Institute, a private maritime college his parents founded, since 2023.

He earned a bachelor's degree in international affairs from The George Washington University in 2018 and a Master of Public Administration from American University in 2023, and in 2017 became a licensed tall ship captain.

sources.title: The Scope's conversation with Senate candidate Morgan Dawicki
